note: Pack v3 (Phase 3 complete) — saare 16 workflows LIVE hain. Boredom Dost ab popup bot type hai (4 buttons); baaki notification type (max 3 buttons, D7).

message.text: Good morning, Boss! My Care aaj bhi aapke saath hai — padhai, araam aur phone ki health, teeno ka khayal rakhenge. Din shubh ho!
message.title: Welcome Boss! 👋

message.text: Apps khol-bund, khol-bund — kuch samajh nahi aa raha kya karein? Kuch accha karte hain:
message.title: Bore ho rahe ho, Boss?

message.text: Aap lagatar {minutes} minutes se phone chala rahe hain. Aankhon ko 2 minute ka break dijiye — padhai bhi fresh dimaag se hoti hai.
message.title: Thoda araam kijiye, Boss

message.text: Aap {minutes} minutes se {app} chala rahe hain. Aap padh rahe ho... nahi... to fail ho jaoge! Agar yeh padhai nahi hai to thoda break le lijiye.
message.title: Ek suggestion hai, Boss

message.text: Good morning! Aaj ki padhai shuru karte hain. Ek chhota sa target rakhiye, phone ko side me rakhiye — My Care nazar rakhega.
message.title: Padhai ka time, Boss 📚

message.text: Kal subah ke liye alarm chahiye? 'Alarm banao' dabakar title likh dijiye — time na likha to subah 6:00 ka alarm lagega. Alag time chahiye to title ke saath 7:30 jaisa time bhi likh sakte hain.
message.title: Alarm laga dun, Boss? ⏰

message.text: Kaafi der ho gayi — ek glass paani pee lijiye. Padhai ke beech hydration se dhyaan bana rehta hai.
message.title: Paani pee lijiye, Boss 💧

message.text: Battery {percent}% ho gayi hai, charger hata dijiye. 1 minute me alarm-style reminder bhi aa jayega.
message.title: ⚠️ Phone Full Charged!

message.text: Battery sirf {percent}% bachi hai. Charger laga dijiye — padhai ke beech phone band na ho jaye.
message.title: Battery low hai, Boss 🔋

message.text: Is screenshot ka kya karein, Boss?
message.title: Screenshot liya gaya

message.text: Auto-delete ka time chunein. Note: Android delete se pehle kabhi-kabhi system confirmation maang sakta hai — woh notification aa jayegi.
message.title: Kab delete karun?

message.text: {name} phone me jud gaya hai. WhatsApp par baat shuru karein?
message.title: Naya contact save hua 👤

message.text: Naya app kis group me rakhein? Notification par tap karke popup se group chunein.
message.title: Naya app install hua 📲

message.text: {app} ka cache {cache} ho gaya hai, Boss. App Info kholkar 'Clear cache' kar dijiye — phone halka rahega.
message.title: Cache bada ho gaya hai 🧹

message.text: Boss, koi aapka phone kholne ki koshish kar raha hai? 2 baar galat password pada hai. Agar yeh aap nahi the to phone apne paas rakhiye.
message.title: Ghuspaithiya Alert! 🚨

message.text: {app} 30 din se zyada se nahi chala hai, Boss (aise kul {count} apps hain). Zarurat na ho to uninstall karke jagah bana dijiye.
message.title: Purane apps ki safai 🗑️
